source_case: M02_L; prefix is not assumed to encode sex

midfoot_import.interpretation: Eight large pieces plus small fragments cannot be assumed to be nine independently identified bones. Do not drop fragments or label components by size alone.

primary_methods_review.section: Magnetic resonance image processing / Statistical shape model generation
facts: Nine midfoot bones were segmented within one mask; wrapping/smoothing preceded STL export.
The authors define coordinate systems for each point cloud and transform segmentations individually before shape registration.
Dataset txt files identify the segment-model input filenames, not native common-frame transforms or individual sex/stature metadata.
primary_methods_review.body_vs_abstract_context: Body reports height 1.73 ± 0.08 m; abstract prints ±0.8 m. Cohort/segmentation counts and sex fractions need their stated denominator, not blind copying.

limits: STL does not encode physical units. Unit conversion is not selected from the filename or plausible AABB alone.
Native common-foot pose/contact frame needs source transforms or independently matched anatomical registration.
No individual 182 cm male case identified; no proportional scaling of this case adopted.
AABB dimensions are axis-dependent source extents, not osteometric whole-bone dimensions.
Vertex mean is not volume centroid, principal inertia axis, or articular contact centre.
next_safe_action: Resolve physical units and native/common-frame transforms; identify all nine midfoot bones independently, then establish envelope/contact references. Use this source for shape context only until those gates close.
